name: agentguard
description: Local tool policy gates and signed, content-free decision records for Codex and ChatGPT Work.

interface.shortDescription: Tool policies, spend limits, and signed local records
interface.longDescription: Apply policies to supported local tool calls in Codex and ChatGPT Work. Record signed decisions and outcomes without retaining tool inputs or output text. Hooks fail open on internal errors.
defaultPrompt: Use agentguard-policy to configure this session.
Use agentguard-status to summarize today's decisions.
Use agentguard-verify to verify and export the signed records.
